request.story_prompt:
Maya is a young girl who enters a mysterious forest alone. Deep inside the forest, she discovers an old Game Machine near a huge tree.
Curious, Maya touches the machine.
Suddenly—
“GAME START!” 🎮
The forest gates close, and Maya becomes trapped inside the game.
🔴 Level 1 – Forest Run
Maya must run through the dark forest while a terrifying shadow chases her. She avoids dangerous obstacles and successfully completes Level 1.
🟠 Level 2 – Mystery House
Maya enters an abandoned house filled with mysterious puzzles. She must solve the puzzles and find the correct exit before the game resets.
Using her intelligence, Maya completes Level 2.
🟢 Level 3 – Final Choice
Maya reaches the final room. On a table, she finds two cards:
1️⃣ LOSE
2️⃣ WIN
A mysterious voice says:
“Choose only one card…”
Maya takes a deep breath and chooses the WIN card.
Suddenly—
💥 GAME COMPLETED! 💥
The door opens, and Maya escapes from the forest.
Outside, she discovers the game's grand prize: bags of money, gold, and treasure. 💰💎

panels.title: The Mysterious Discovery
panels.scene_description: Alex, a young boy with messy hair and a backpack, stands before a colossal, glowing tree in the heart of an enchanted forest. He reaches out to touch an ancient, flickering arcade machine embedded in the tree's roots.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, a young boy named Alex standing in a dark enchanted forest, magical glowing tree, an old retro arcade machine with a cracked screen, vibrant colors, dramatic lighting, detailed ink lines.

panels.title: Level One: The Shadow Chase
panels.scene_description: The forest transforms into a digital landscape. Alex is sprinting through a dark, pixelated forest path while a towering, amorphous shadow monster looms right behind him.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, action shot, Alex running fast, terrified expression, giant dark shadow creature chasing him, glowing digital glitch effects on the forest trees, motion blur, dynamic composition.

panels.title: Level Two: The Puzzle House
panels.scene_description: Alex stands inside a dusty, abandoned Victorian room filled with floating holographic puzzles. He is focused, holding a glowing geometric key piece as he fits it into a locked door.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, interior of a spooky abandoned house, dusty atmosphere, Alex solving a complex glowing holographic puzzle, intense focus, mysterious shadows in the background, sharp details.

panels.title: Level Three: The Final Choice
panels.scene_description: Alex stands in a void-like room. On a stone pedestal before him lie two floating cards: one labeled 'LOSE' and one labeled 'WIN'. He reaches out with trembling fingers toward the 'WIN' card.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, close up on Alex's face, sweat on his brow, two glowing cards floating in mid-air, one says WIN in gold, one says LOSE in red, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, suspenseful atmosphere.

panels.title: Victory and Fortune
panels.scene_description: The game explodes in a shower of golden pixels. Alex stands safely back in the forest, surrounded by overflowing chests of gold coins, jewels, and treasure that appeared as his reward.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, wide shot, Alex standing triumphant in the forest, bright golden light, chests overflowing with gold and gems, 'GAME COMPLETED' floating in the air in bold comic letters, bright and celebratory colors.
